name: resource-64mib-stream-unleashed
title: 64 MiB resource stream · 1 Gbps policy
summary: Stream the 64 MiB resource with both endpoint TCP interfaces explicitly configured for the 1 Gbps MTU tier.
notes: Controlled computational comparison: identical workload and protocol, with only TCP bitrate policy changed.

cell_notes.text: This controlled row retains the RNS-sender/Prns-receiver segment-handoff interaction identified by the default-policy cell. A higher MTU can change how often successor preparation wins the race, but it does not remove RNS 1.4.0's 50 ms readiness-polling path; compare this result with both the default 64 MiB row and the one-segment control.

description: The 64 MiB incompressible resource stream repeated with both real initiator and responder TCP interfaces explicitly configured for 1 Gbps. That policy selects the 524,288-byte interface MTU tier on both stacks. Compression remains disabled and every segment remains encrypted, hash-proved, assembled, and application-acknowledged; this is the controlled counterpart to the default-policy result.
conformance: Every sent stream settles, receives its ordered application acknowledgement, and is received with exact application-byte totals and zero failures; each transfer is a sequence of hash-proved segments assembled by original_hash before the whole is counted.
